## 2. HMG4PE1 self-contained paragraph-preimage envelope

V2.13 HMG4AL3 remains normative for the 21 reviewer-local rows, 23 forward/reverse mapping edges, twelve canonical targets, and all 42 problem/remediation SHA-256 values. V2.14 replaces HMG4AL3’s dependency on later access to historical task outputs with the self-contained HMG4PE1 envelope below. The envelope makes the paragraph hashes independently recomputable; it does not convert the historical reviews into user-owned reviews, validate their methodology, or create any authority.

Each HMG4PE1 row is ASCII and has exactly eight pipe-delimited fields:

```text
unit|priority|local-id|problem-byte-length|problem-base64|remediation-byte-length|remediation-base64|comma-delimited-canonical-ids
```

Unit, priority, local ID, canonical IDs, and row order must exactly equal the corresponding HMG4AL3 row. Lengths are canonical unsigned decimal without a sign or leading zero. Base64 is canonical padded RFC 4648 standard-alphabet Base64 with no whitespace. Each decoded field must be valid UTF-8, contain no NUL/CR/LF, have exactly the displayed byte length, and re-encode byte-for-byte to the displayed Base64. Reviewers must SHA-256 each decoded paragraph without adding a terminator and match the corresponding HMG4AL3 digest. Every envelope row has one LF, including the final row; row order is F1..F10, A1..A4, W1..W7.

## 3. New user-owned v2.14 independent-review batch

The user’s prior task-creation authorization named only v2.13 SHA-256 `e8395f34d83b4a9e12fbe426473a7f97afd1b35dfcb20b613813351c21e0e123`. It does not authorize v2.14 review tasks. This authoring action creates none. After v2.14 is frozen, a new authenticated user-role instruction must explicitly request exactly three new user-owned Codex tasks for the exact v2.14 path and SHA-256, with scopes `schema`, `adversarial`, and `whole`. No v2.13 task, initial client placeholder, hidden subagent, collaboration agent, local transcript, or root-authored substitute may be reused.

After all three task-system IDs exist, HMG4RB4 is SHA-256 of exactly:

```text
ASCII HMG4RB4 LF
v2.14 contract SHA-256 lowercase hex LF
schema task ID UTF-8 LF
adversarial task ID UTF-8 LF
whole task ID UTF-8 LF
```

The order is schema, adversarial, whole. IDs must be nonempty, distinct task-system returned values with no NUL/CR/LF. Each task receives the exact original absolute path, contract SHA-256, HMG4RB4 batch ID, all three ordered task IDs, its scope, HMG4GL4/HMG4AL3/HMG4PE1/HMG4FR3 identities, the unresolved V28 state, and the complete no-write/no-execution boundary.

The schema unit must independently reconstruct HMG4GL4, validate HMG4AL3, decode and hash all 42 HMG4PE1 paragraphs, compare every row/edge/target, and audit all inherited production-contract grammar. The adversarial unit must attack task ownership, replay/mixed-batch/root spoofing, original-output availability, Base64/length/hash aliases, command-failure disclosure, user authentication, V28 preservation, clean-room isolation, and every path to implementation/runtime authority. The whole unit must read byte 1 through EOF, validate the full lineage and all retained exclusions, independently repeat the structural and paragraph checks, and confirm no authority expansion.

Before any evidence-bearing command, each reviewer must label the command and the exact claims it tests. A failure, error, ambiguous output, or correction in any evidence-bearing command invalidates that unit permanently. Exploratory diagnostics are not evidence; every diagnostic failure is disclosed and no failed command is silently omitted. Each task establishes the original target’s complete before and immediate-final after identity with one predeclared portable successful method, including path, SHA-256, UTF-8 bytes, LF count, type, mode, nlink, and available inode/xattr/ACL/flags observations.

Each final output must echo its own task ID, all ordered IDs, HMG4RB4, scope, exact target identity before/after, P0/P1/P2 with every finding or explicit zero, HMG4GL4, HMG4AL3, all-42 HMG4PE1 result, HMG4FR3 interpretation, operational-freeze state, complete command/error disclosure, completion result, and the closed no-authority statement. A nonzero or invalidated unit is never consolidated as zero.

The parent must read each original final output through the task system and record the exposed final-message/turn identity, exact UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256, completion state, completion timestamp, and final-LF state. The user must be able to open each original task independently. Missing access, unavailable exact bytes, reused/duplicate IDs, stale output, wrong scope/hash/batch, mixed batch, root-authored substitute, finding suppression, incomplete task, or task-system ambiguity fails.

Only if all three fresh original outputs target unchanged v2.14 bytes, are complete and independently `P0/P1/P2=0/0/0`, and all structures pass with an empty finding union may the parent describe a transient `spec-review-qualified` state. It has no implementation or runtime authority. After seeing the original tasks and consolidation, the user must send a new authenticated message naming the v2.14 SHA-256, HMG4RB4, all three task IDs, all three output SHA-256 values, combined `0/0/0`, exact next action, V28 disposition, and retained exclusions. Earlier authorization is insufficient.

## 4. Retained clean-room and V28 operational boundary

V2.13 Section 4 remains normative with only these mechanical substitutions: every required exposed successor contract is v2.14 rather than v2.13; every qualifying review reference is the fresh HMG4RB4 batch; and the root plus every reviewer through v2.14 is presumptively disqualified as implementer. All other no-fork/no-memory/no-retired-source, closed-membership offline environment, allowlisted toolchain, transcript, no-overwrite, parser-only pre-runtime test, provenance/access review, similarity review, and later implementation-security-review rules remain unchanged.

The exact v2.12 Section 5 preservation rules remain normative. Current V28 state remains 57 writable mode-`0644` files, 48 native members, nine non-Gate-A top-level runners, 553,897 total bytes, checksum-set SHA-256 `cfa98f5fd9a101c35944b4ef59a8b5db36f3a799ee7821ca4e286476acea3200`, and native-root mode `0755`. Operational freeze is false. This contract authorizes no chmod, ACL, xattr, flag, copy, move, quarantine, repair, delete, rollback, or other V28 transition.

No implementation task may be created until a valid v2.14 batch and exact post-review user authorization exist, V28 has been separately authorized and two independent full-rehash projections agree, the clean-room isolation pack is independently approved, and current v2 through v2.6 hashes still match. Any future implementation must use a new user-owned task, new output directory, no inherited retired implementation knowledge, and no repository/original-runtime access. A later independent implementation review must reach current P0/P1/P2=0/0/0 before helper or original-runtime execution.
